notes: IMDuel on Ethereum (chain 1): chess played by trades. Constructor arguments in declaration order: manager = $poolManager; engine = ChessEngineV5 at 0xc21788f704a8b9456f7391a01d8a3d95be215a27 (launch/deployed.json; the constructor does not check its code, so the hook builds where the engine has none); imd = IMD 0xd34a99bc0f67ae1bbd63c660e6d0b0dd03e263b7; ethFee 10000 and ethSpacing 200: the hookless IMD / native ETH pool the ETH protocol slice is sold in (no route hook, so no such argument); minImd 10 IMD, minEth 0.02 ETH, minImduel 1,000,000 IMDUEL: the smallest pile worth one conversion batch; turnBlocks 3: how many blocks a move takes bids for. No owner, admin, pause, upgrade path or backend signer: nothing is $owner or $factory. The token is src/IMDuelToken.sol on the standard terms: IMDuel (IMDUEL), 1,000,000,000 fixed, 18 decimals, minted whole to the factory, plain transfers, no owner, mint, burn, tax, pause or blocklist. The factory deploys the hook and the token and opens this pool (IMD pair, fee 12500, spacing 60) in one transaction; the first pool opened on the hook is the main duel and must pair IMD (afterInitialize reverts otherwise), its other currency becomes IMDUEL; every later duel must pair IMD, IMDUEL or native ETH (NoRoute otherwise) and never pays the opening surcharge. Fee: 0.5% of every swap of its pools through beforeSwapReturnDelta / afterSwapReturnDelta, on top of the untouched 1.25% LP fee: 0.4% to the pool's war chest (reward pool) worth less at the pool price, 0.1% protocol slice converted into IMDUEL, half to the main duel's IMDUEL chest and half burned to 0x...dEaD; for the main duel's first 300 seconds the chest share starts 25% higher and falls linearly to 0.4%, all of it to the chest (time only, nothing per wallet). A swap must trade its whole order: one its price limit stops early reverts (PartialFill). Liquidity callbacks are not used; the factory's zero-liquidity fee collection passes untouched. Conversion batches (convert / convertBatch, anyone may call) spend at most 10 minimums, run at most once per block per pool and buy within 0.1% of the most hook-favourable sqrt price its pool had at the start of its three latest sampled blocks; the main duel is sampled before every trade and batch; the IMD / ETH route is sampled only through sampleRoute, a permissionless proof of a past block-start slot0 (header against BLOCKHASH, PoolManager account and storage proofs, verified by the RoutePriceVerifier the constructor creates). Without fresh route samples the ETH pile simply waits as claims. Play: every buy bids for its team's next move (the owner is the 20- or 32-byte address in hookData, else the swap's sender; never tx.origin); the biggest owns it and a new top bid must pay more than 10% over the current one; a move takes bids for 3 blocks (about 36 s) after the previous one was played, and the first swap after its window plays it through a gas-capped external call to the engine, seeded by the hash of the window's last block (BLOCKHASH, or the EIP-2935 history contract beyond 256 blocks; a hash no longer served gives a 0% timeout turn). An engine failure never reverts a swap; an engine starved by the swap's own gas limit reverts it (NotEnoughGas). A move's reward is paid from its team's chest in the swap's unlock; a payout whose recipient reverts, cannot receive ETH or touches the PoolManager's deltas is refused (Unsettled) and left owed: withdraw(who, c) sends it to the owed party, withdrawTo(c, to) lets the owed party collect it elsewhere.
